_readme: Shop product feeds from affiliate networks (Adtraction, Awin, Partner-ads …). The feed URL contains your personal key, so it is NOT written here: put it in a GitHub secret (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions) with the name in 'url_secret'. Feeds without a secret are skipped. 'format' auto-detects CSV/TSV/XML/JSON (also .gz). 'fields' maps unusual column names if auto-detection misses them.
